**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Apply the worker flag transform during development**

When the site runs through `npm run dev`, this transformer is not applied to worker modules: [Vite documents](https://vite.dev/config/worker-options) that top-level `config.plugins` applies to workers in development, while `worker.plugins` configures worker bundles for builds. Consequently, the global define above leaves `ZODIACS_BIRTH_WINDOW_WORKER` false in the dev-served `full.ts`, so every window request throws `Worker only` and displays the generic failure message even though production previews work. Register the same transform in the development plugin pipeline while preserving `full.ts` as the engine boundary. [CLAUDE.mdL295-L303](https://github.com/zodiacs-org/site/blob/814727d852ec927bcfbce68ed33a1a9e2e576554/CLAUDE.md#L295-L303)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

observedScope: Fresh source review identifies a development pipeline omission. The earlier native production-preview pass remains real but establishes no development behavior.
correction: Register the full.ts marker transform in the top-level serve-only pipeline. The existing worker-build plugin and false production page define remain unchanged. Use the original thirteen-control browser harness in both development and production-preview modes, retaining distinct reports and native transport assertions.
qualification: Pending actual native Node/build/unit/bundle/development/production/visual/performance/capture gates on the corrected source. No clean-review or deployment acceptance is claimed.
